calibration.rule: largest alpha with S4 specificity ≥ 0.995 (Wilson lower ≥ 0.99) and sensitivity at 180 events ≥ 0.95 (A) and ≥ 0.90 (B, C, E); if none meets the sensitivity, the largest that meets the specificity

criteria_180_events.detection_A: lower Wilson limit of the sensitivity >= 0.95
criteria_180_events.s5b_occupation: lower limit of the 95 % CI of ΔAUC-PR > −0.01 against retraining and against the mode
